content: Customer Ishaan Bose calls insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to discuss renewing his Health Plus plan and upgrading to the Comprehensive Care Plan. Sunita breaks down the pricing ($425/month, reduced to $403.75 with the 5% early-renewal discount) and confirms the $10 processing fee. Ishaan successfully processes the payment for the renewed policy starting 01/10/2026. He also inquires about document requirements (signed renewal form and utility bill) and subsequently requests the addition of the Global Traveller Rider for international coverage ($25/month), for which Sunita agrees to send details and a separate payment link.

action_items: Agent to email signed renewal form and instructions for proof of address
Customer to provide signed renewal form and electricity bill
Agent to send Global Traveller Rider details and separate payment link
